items.caption: News for your daily commute.
items.alt: A pencil-style drawing of Thomas Jefferson in a carriage, reading news on a smartphone.

items.caption: News for your daily commute, even across the Delaware.
items.alt: An engraving-style take on Washington Crossing the Delaware, with Thomas Jefferson in the boat reading news on a smartphone.

items.caption: News for your daily commute. Then, eyes up.
items.alt: A pencil-style drawing of soldiers in a landing craft approaching Normandy in 1944, one of them reading news on a smartphone.

items.caption: News for your daily commute, all 240,000 miles of it.
items.alt: A pencil-style drawing of three Apollo-era astronauts strapped into their capsule, the middle one reading news on a smartphone.

items.caption: News for your daily commute. Land can wait five minutes.
items.alt: A pencil-style drawing of 15th-century explorers rowing ashore on a tropical beach as their captain points ahead, while one sailor reads news on a smartphone.

items.caption: News for your daily commute. The Pacific isn’t going anywhere.
items.alt: A pencil-style drawing of an early 1800s frontier expedition walking beside a covered wagon across the plains, while one traveler in the wagon reads news on a smartphone.

items.caption: Don’t miss out on the important opportunities.
items.alt: A pencil-style drawing of 1849 gold rush miners panning in a stream, while one miner sits reading news on a smartphone.

items.caption: News for your daily commute. Now boarding: the evening edition.
items.alt: A pencil-style drawing of a 1940s airliner cabin with passengers in suits and hats and a stewardess walking the aisle, while one passenger reads news on a smartphone.

items.caption: Some news can’t wait. The rest takes five minutes.
items.alt: A pencil-style drawing of a colonial rider galloping through town at night shouting "The British are coming!" while a man outside a coffee house, looking at his smartphone, asks "Do I have 5 minutes?"

items.caption: News for your daily commute. Eyes on the road later.
items.alt: A pencil-style drawing of a vintage sidecar motorcycle on a curve, the driver focused while the passenger in the sidecar reads news on a smartphone.

items.caption: We’ll bring you the news so you can focus on your reading, ’riting, and ’rithmetic.
items.alt: Pencil drawing of a 19th-century schoolroom where one student secretly looks at a phone.
